metadata.title: Daniel
metadata.subtitle: Daniel 1:1 – 12:13 (37 questions)
metadata.description: Questions on the Book of Daniel according to the King James Version (1769).
metadata.author: King James Version (1769)

questions.text: What purpose did Daniel lay in his heart at the king's court (Daniel 1:8)?

options.text: He would not learn the tongue and learning of the Chaldeans
He would not defile himself with the king's meat nor with his wine
He would not bow down himself before the princes of the palace
He would not dwell in the royal house, but in a tent outside

questions.text: Of what substances was the great image composed in Nebuchadnezzar's dream (Daniel 2:32-33)?

options.text: Head of brass, breast of iron, belly of gold, thighs of silver, feet of clay
Head of silver, breast of gold, belly of brass, thighs of iron, feet of clay
Head of gold, breast of silver, belly of brass, legs of iron, feet of clay
Head of gold, breast of brass, belly of silver, legs of iron, feet of clay

questions.text: What became of the stone that smote the great image (Daniel 2:35)?

options.text: It became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth
It brake into many pieces and sank into depths of sea
It was brought unto Jerusalem and preserved in temple
It melted away completely before the heat of Chaldeans

questions.text: Who walked with the three men in the midst of the burning furnace (Daniel 3:25)?

options.text: A fourth man, whose form was like the Son of God
An holy angel that extinguished all fiery flames
The prophet Daniel, who entered in to save them
The king of Babylon, who repented of his fury

questions.text: What did the dream of the tree foretell unto King Nebuchadnezzar (Daniel 4:25)?

options.text: He should conquer all kingdoms from east unto west and dwell in peace
They shall drive him from men, his dwelling with beasts, eating grass
He should perish by the sword of his own captains and be forgotten
His royal palace should be burnt with fire and his crown cast down

questions.text: What writing appeared upon the plaster of the wall at Belshazzar's feast (Daniel 5:25)?

options.text: Kadosh, kadosh, kadosh, adonai
Eli, eli, lama sabachthani
MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN
Ichabod, ichabod, maranatha

questions.text: Why was Daniel cast into the den of lions according to Daniel 6:10-16?

options.text: Because he refused to worship the golden image set up in Babylon
Because he spoke evil words against the royal majesty of Darius
Because he hid the holy vessels of the temple in his secret chamber
Because he prayed to his God three times a day against royal decree

questions.text: How was the fourth beast described in Daniel's night vision (Daniel 7:7)?

options.text: Dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly, with great iron teeth
Like a raging winged lion having a human heart and roaring aloud
Like an huge bear devouring much flesh in the desolate wilderness
Like a leopard having four heads and great dominion over all beasts

questions.text: Who came with the clouds of heaven unto the Ancient of days in Daniel 7:13?

options.text: A glorious company of holy angels with silver trumpets
One like the Son of man, unto whom dominion was given
The prophet Elijah, returning in a swift fiery chariot
King David of Israel, restored in great royal splendour

questions.text: Which angel appeared unto Daniel to explain the vision of seventy weeks (Daniel 9:21)?

options.text: The archangel Uriel
The archangel Raphael
The man Gabriel
The archangel Michael

questions.text: Who came to help the heavenly messenger against the prince of Persia (Daniel 10:13)?

options.text: A mighty legion of cherubim with swords
The angel Gabriel, flying swiftly to him
The prophet Elijah in a chariot of fire
Michael, one of the chief princes

questions.text: How did Daniel and his companions appear at the end of ten days (Daniel 1:15)?

options.text: Faint and pale in countenance compared to all other children
Fairer and fatter in flesh than all children eating king's meat
Entirely unchanged and just like all the other royal children
Feeble and sickly in body through their refusal of royal meat

questions.text: What blessing did Daniel speak when the secret was revealed (Daniel 2:20-21)?

options.text: Holy, holy is the God of heaven; He shall overthrow all heathen foes
Great is the wisdom of the Chaldeans; peace be unto the royal house
Blessed be God for ever: He removeth kings, and setteth up kings
Praise the LORD upon the harp; He delivereth His saints from death

questions.text: What did Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego answer the king (Daniel 3:17-18)?

options.text: Grant us thirty days to consider, that we may consult our elders
We will bow down this once, but our hearts remain faithful to God
The burning fiery furnace cannot hurt us because of our righteousness
Our God is able to deliver us; but if not, we will not serve thy gods

questions.text: What vision foretold the humiliation of Nebuchadnezzar (Daniel 4:7-14)?

options.text: A mighty ship of Tyre broken by an east wind in the midst of seas
A great tree reaching unto heaven, whose leaves were fair, hewn down
A golden chariot overthrown and burned with fire in the desert
A great image of four metals crushed into fine dust by a stone

questions.text: What did Nebuchadnezzar do when his understanding returned (Daniel 4:34)?

options.text: He built a new golden palace and doubled his royal standing army
He assembled all astrologers and rewarded them with gifts of gold
He lifted his eyes to heaven, and blessed and praised the most High
He commanded all images of strange gods to be broken in pieces

questions.text: What sacrilege did Belshazzar commit at his great feast (Daniel 5:2-4)?

options.text: He burned sacred incense before the carved images of the Chaldeans
He proclaimed himself to be an immortal god in the sight of all
He cast down the altar of sacrifice and mocked the prophets of God
He drank wine with his lords out of golden vessels from the temple

questions.text: What is the interpretation of the words written on the wall (Daniel 5:26-28)?

options.text: God hath numbered thy kingdom; thou art weighed; it is divided
Thy reign shall be prolonged; thy enemies shall fall before thee
A great famine cometh; prepare bread and wine for seven years
Peace be unto the king; Babylon shall stand firm unto all ages

questions.text: What royal decree did King Darius make after Daniel's deliverance (Daniel 6:26-27)?

options.text: Daniel was exalted to be chief governor over all royal provinces
All lions in the dens throughout the realm should be destroyed
Men should tremble and fear before the living God of Daniel
No man in all the kingdom should offer sacrifice unto any idol

questions.text: Which four beasts did Daniel see come up from the sea (Daniel 7:3-7)?

options.text: A lion, a wolf, an eagle, and a dragon with fiery breath
A bull, an hart, a serpent, and a monster with iron horns
A ram, an he goat, a camel, and a beast with brass claws
A lion, a bear, a leopard, and a diverse beast with ten horns

questions.text: Which two beasts did Daniel behold by the river of Ulai (Daniel 8:3-8)?

options.text: A ram having two high horns, and an he goat coming from the west
A lion with eagle's wings, and a bear having three ribs in teeth
A leopard with four heads, and a dreadful beast with iron teeth
A bull with silver horns, and an eagle flying over all rivers

questions.text: What did the little horn do according to Daniel 8:10-12?

options.text: It made peace with the saints and restored the altar of the LORD
It magnified itself, took away daily sacrifice, cast down truth
It built a great temple unto the gods of Greece throughout Asia
It divided the royal realm equally among the four winds of earth

questions.text: How long until the sanctuary should be cleansed according to Daniel 8:14?

options.text: Unto twelve hundred and sixty days
Unto seventy weeks of years
Unto two thousand and three hundred days
Unto forty days and forty nights

questions.text: Where did Daniel understand the number of years of Jerusalem's desolation (Daniel 9:2)?

options.text: From the prophecies of the prophet Isaiah
From the ancient holy psalms of King David
From the visions of Ezekiel by river Chebar
From the books of Jeremiah for seventy years

questions.text: How many weeks are determined upon Daniel's people and holy city (Daniel 9:24)?

options.text: Exactly seventy weeks
Exactly seven weeks
Exactly twelve weeks
Seven hundred weeks

questions.text: What was the appearance of the man seen by the river Hiddekel (Daniel 10:5-6)?

options.text: A warrior in glittering armor having a drawn sword in hand
Clothed in linen, girded with fine gold, body like a beryl
An ancient prophet having a snow white beard and wooden staff
A glorious cherub of heaven having six fiery wings of light

questions.text: What kings are foretold at the beginning of the prophecy in Daniel 11:2?

options.text: Seven judges in Israel, followed by a royal king over people
Three kings in Egypt, followed by a fourth with a great host
Twelve kings of Rome, followed by a mighty emperor over realm
Three kings in Persia, followed by a fourth far richer than all

questions.text: Between which two powers does the conflict rage in Daniel 11:5-6?

options.text: The king of the south and the king of the north
The king of the east and the king of the west
The prince of Persia and the prince of Grecia
The realm of Babylon and the empire of Egypt

questions.text: What transgression shall arms commit according to Daniel 11:31?

options.text: They shall burn the gates of Jerusalem and carry away the people
They shall pollute the sanctuary and place the abomination desolate
They shall crown a false high priest and change the holy sabbaths
They shall break in pieces the golden ark and cast it into river

questions.text: Who shall stand up for the children of Daniel's people (Daniel 12:1)?

options.text: Gabriel, the holy messenger of God
David, the anointed king of Israel
Michael, the great prince that standeth
Elijah, the zealous prophet of fire

questions.text: What is promised unto them that sleep in the dust and to the wise (Daniel 12:2-3)?

options.text: They shall possess all kingdoms of the world and reign on earth
Their names shall be recorded in the golden book of the kings
They shall build the holy temple in Jerusalem with pure gold
Many shall awake to life; they that be wise shall shine as stars

questions.text: With what words does the Book of Daniel conclude (Daniel 12:13)?

options.text: Go thy way till the end be: for thou shalt rest, and stand in thy lot
Weep not, Daniel, for thy people shall be delivered out of captivity
Seal up the book until the day when the Ancient of days shall appear
Blessed is he that waiteth, and cometh to the thousand days

questions.text: What are the Babylonian names of the three friends of Daniel in Daniel 3:12?

options.text: Shadrach
Meshach
Belshazzar
Abed-nego

questions.text: Who said unto Nebuchadnezzar: "Our God whom we serve is able to deliver us... but if not... we will not serve thy gods" (Daniel 3:17-18)?

options.text: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego
Daniel, Hananiah, and Azariah
The wise men and astrologers of Babylon
The princes and captains of the provinces

questions.text: Order the parts of the image in Nebuchadnezzar's dream from top to bottom.

options.text: Feet part of iron and part of clay
Legs of iron
Breast and arms of silver
Belly and thighs of brass
Head of fine gold

questions.text: Order the four beasts of Daniel's vision in the sequence in which they appeared.

options.text: The dreadful beast with ten horns
The lion with eagle's wings
The bear with three ribs in its mouth
The leopard with four wings

questions.text: Whither were the open windows in Daniel's chamber directed when he prayed (Daniel 6:10)?

options.text: Toward the desert in the east, whence he awaited aid
Toward Jerusalem, in which direction he prayed to God
Toward the palace of the king, unto whom he was loyal
Toward the river Euphrates, where he sought quietness
